improvements_suggested: Apply same-verdict gate retirement to terminalize repeated Full-Scale Pipeline v3 and arXiv Bundle evaluations.
Implement activation-time readiness artifacts to catch doomed-rerun preflight blocks in <1s.

meta_reflection: The retrospective loop confirms the same known structural bottlenecks (gate churn, idle GPUs) that were observed in prior milestones; mechanical enforcement in the conductor is needed to realize the estimated 55% savings.
